notes: Fires to execute an existing suite and report results. Boundary case tests that a request to author test cases routes to unit-test/integration-test, not run-tests.

evals.prompt: Run the full test suite and tell me whether everything passes.
evals.expected_output: Detects test commands from PROJECT.md, runs backend and frontend suites with coverage (type check first), emits the Test Run Result table (totals/passed/failed/coverage/status), checks the quality gates, and on failure routes to fix-bug (clear cause) or systematic-debugging (flaky/unclear). Does not author new tests.

evals.prompt: Run just the payment module tests and show me the results.
evals.expected_output: Runs the scoped module test command from PROJECT.md, reports pass/fail counts and coverage in the quick-report format, and flags any failed tests with error and file.

evals.prompt: Write test cases for the payment module.
evals.expected_output: Should route to unit-test (or integration-test), not fire, because run-tests only executes an existing suite — authoring test cases is NOT FOR run-tests.
